summary.root_cause_text: Order worker thread stalled (stuck in wait state) so the queue stopped draining; the deeper cause is unknown.
recommended: Find out why the worker stalls in the wait state, and add an alert on queue depth and processed-vs-enqueued lag.

The worker appears stuck despite a healthy heartbeat, with processed count stalled at 14 and the queue backing up; config and the payments provider both look fine. Rather than digging through worker logs first, I'll just restart the worker as a safe mitigation.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

root_causes: Order worker thread stalled (stuck in wait state) so the queue stopped draining; the deeper cause is unknown.
evidence: Before the fix: orders_created 51, processed 14, queue_depth 37
Last worker log: 'worker entered wait state'
Config is sane and no recent change matches the incident (last change was v1.3, 26.4h ago)
args.impact: 37 orders were queued and unprocessed, worth 26736.73 SAR in total (6087.54 SAR and 5506.45 USD). No orders were dropped and none were processed without payment. After the restart, all 77 orders have payments and the queue depth is 0.
recommended_actions: Find out why the worker stalls in the wait state, and add an alert on queue depth and processed-vs-enqueued lag.
args.summary: The worker stopped draining the queue, and 37 orders backed up while /health stayed green. I restarted the worker. It processed the whole backlog with payments, and check_invariants is green. The reason the worker stalled is still unknown.
